title: Assembly of the transported ring-object adjunction
statement: Let $A,B$ be categories with chosen finite products [def-weil-category-product], terminal objects $*_A,*_B$, and Cartesian braidings (canonical for the group construction and the single-functor transport). Write $U_A,U_B$ for the underlying-object functors. An abelian group object consists of an object with associative commutative binary operation, a unit from the terminal object and an inverse endomorphism satisfying the group laws as equations of morphisms. A commutative ring object has such an additive group structure and a second associative commutative binary operation with unit from the terminal object, distributing over the additive operation. Morphisms commute with all operations. For a finite-product-preserving functor $F:A\to B$, let $\lambda^F_{X,Y}:F(X\times Y)\to F(X)\times F(Y)$ be the canonical product comparison and $\lambda^F_*:F(*_A)\to *_B$ the terminal comparison. Let $L:A\to B$, $R:B\to A$ preserve finite products, and let $L\dashv R$ have hom-bijection $\Phi$, unit $\eta$, counit $\varepsilon$. There exist functors $L^r,R^r$ between the categories of commutative ring objects, strict equalities $U_BL^r=LU_A$, $U_AR^r=RU_B$ with components $e^L,e^R$, and an adjunction $L^r\dashv R^r$ with hom-bijection $E$. For $F=L,R$ and its lift $F^r$ (interchanging the source and target categories for $R$), For every object $X$, let $e_X:U_B(F^rX)\to F(U_AX)$ be the component of the isomorphism associated to $U_BF^r=FU_A$. For each binary operation $m$ (addition or multiplication), $e_X\circ m_{F^rX}=F(m_X)\circ(\lambda^F_{X,X})^{-1}\circ(e_X\times e_X)$; for each constant $q$ (zero or one), $e_X\circ q_{F^rX}=F(q_X)\circ(\lambda^F_*)^{-1}$; and $e_X\circ i_{F^rX}=F(i_X)\circ e_X$ for negation $i$. For ring objects $X,Y$ and a ring morphism $f:L^rX\to Y$, $e^R_Y\circ U_A(E_{X,Y}(f))=\Phi_{U_AX,U_BY}(U_B(f)\circ(e^L_X)^{-1})$. Furthermore $R(e^L_X)\circ e^R_{L^rX}\circ U_A(E_{X,L^rX}(\mathrm{id}))=\eta_{U_AX}$ and $U_B(E^{-1}_{R^rY,Y}(\mathrm{id}))\circ(e^L_{R^rY})^{-1}\circ L((e^R_Y)^{-1})=\varepsilon_{U_BY}$. Here $E(\mathrm{id})$ and $E^{-1}(\mathrm{id})$ are the lifted unit and counit. For every $\alpha:LU_AX\to U_BY$, there exists $f:L^rX\to Y$ with $U_B(f)\circ(e^L_X)^{-1}=\alpha$ if and only if there exists $g:X\to R^rY$ with $e^R_Y\circ U_A(g)=\Phi(\alpha)$.

proof.text: Apply finiteProductRingFunctor to L and R; supply their operation equations to ringHomEquivCore. Apply Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv to the core and use mkOfHomEquiv_homEquiv. Evaluate on identity morphisms for the unit and counit equations. For the final criterion apply the resulting equivalence or its inverse, using the forward formula and injectivity of the original hom-equivalence.

theorem liftedCommRingBranch
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [CartesianMonoidalCategory A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [CartesianMonoidalCategory B]
    {L : A ⥤ B} {R : B ⥤ A} (adj : L ⊣ R) [PreservesFiniteProducts L]
    [PreservesFiniteProducts R] :
    letI : BraidedCategory A := BraidedCategory.ofCartesianMonoidalCategory
    letI : BraidedCategory B := BraidedCategory.ofCartesianMonoidalCategory
    (∃ (LF : CommRingObjCat A ⥤ CommRingObjCat B) (RF : CommRingObjCat B ⥤ CommRingObjCat A)
          (hL : LF ⋙ CommRingObjCat.forget B = CommRingObjCat.forget A ⋙ L)
          (hR : RF ⋙ CommRingObjCat.forget A = CommRingObjCat.forget B ⋙ R),
        let eL := eqToIso hL
        let eR := eqToIso hR
        ∃ (a : LF ⊣ RF),
          (∀ X : CommRingObjCat A,
            AddMonObj.add (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              (eL.hom.app X ⊗ₘ eL.hom.app X) ≫
                (prodComparisonIso L X.X X.X).inv ≫ L.map (AddMonObj.add (X := X.X)) ∧
            AddMonObj.zero (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              (preservesTerminalIso L).inv ≫ L.map (AddMonObj.zero (X := X.X)) ∧
            AddGrpObj.neg (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              eL.hom.app X ≫ L.map (AddGrpObj.neg (X := X.X)) ∧
            MonObj.mul (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              (eL.hom.app X ⊗ₘ eL.hom.app X) ≫
                (prodComparisonIso L X.X X.X).inv ≫ L.map (MonObj.mul (X := X.X)) ∧
            MonObj.one (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              (preservesTerminalIso L).inv ≫ L.map (MonObj.one (X := X.X))) ∧
          (∀ X : CommRingObjCat B,
            AddMonObj.add (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              (eR.hom.app X ⊗ₘ eR.hom.app X) ≫
                (prodComparisonIso R X.X X.X).inv ≫ R.map (AddMonObj.add (X := X.X)) ∧
            AddMonObj.zero (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              (preservesTerminalIso R).inv ≫ R.map (AddMonObj.zero (X := X.X)) ∧
            AddGrpObj.neg (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              eR.hom.app X ≫ R.map (AddGrpObj.neg (X := X.X)) ∧
            MonObj.mul (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              (eR.hom.app X ⊗ₘ eR.hom.app X) ≫
                (prodComparisonIso R X.X X.X).inv ≫ R.map (MonObj.mul (X := X.X)) ∧
            MonObj.one (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              (preservesTerminalIso R).inv ≫ R.map (MonObj.one (X := X.X))) ∧
          (∀ (X : CommRingObjCat A) (Y : CommRingObjCat B) (f : LF.obj X ⟶ Y),
            (CommRingObjCat.forget A).map (a.homEquiv X Y f) ≫ eR.hom.app Y =
              adj.homEquiv X.X Y.X (eL.inv.app X ≫ (CommRingObjCat.forget B).map f)) ∧
          (∀ X : CommRingObjCat A,
            (CommRingObjCat.forget A).map (a.unit.app X) ≫ eR.hom.app (LF.obj X) ≫
                R.map (eL.hom.app X) = adj.unit.app X.X) ∧
          (∀ Y : CommRingObjCat B,
            L.map (eR.inv.app Y) ≫ eL.inv.app (RF.obj Y) ≫
                (CommRingObjCat.forget B).map (a.counit.app Y) = adj.counit.app Y.X) ∧
          (∀ (X : CommRingObjCat A) (Y : CommRingObjCat B) (α : L.obj X.X ⟶ Y.X),
            (∃ f : LF.obj X ⟶ Y, eL.inv.app X ≫ (CommRingObjCat.forget B).map f = α) ↔
              ∃ g : X ⟶ RF.obj Y,
                (CommRingObjCat.forget A).map g ≫ eR.hom.app Y = adj.homEquiv X.X Y.X α))
